name: Punto Tricolor Ops
tagline: Daily ops support for a small business in Colombia, briefing to bookings
description: Built around a small local company rather than a startup team. Each weekday morning it delivers a technology briefing as voice, a separate agent takes customer orders, table reservations and appointments, and a prospecting pass works through nearby restaurants and clinics. One desk carrying the daily load.
author: cyberandres
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
